lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits are arranged in a grid-like pattern consisting of approximately six discernible vertical columns and five horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular coordinate-like matrix across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense population of smaller, high-luminance spots towards its distal edge. Several commensal organisms (remoras) are visible trailing the posterior gill region and the ventral side of the pectoral fin.
